dose_adult.indication: Tratamento de curto prazo de sintomas de ansiedade
dose_adult.note: A bula indica 2 a 10 mg, duas a quatro vezes ao dia (4 a 40 mg/dia), para adultos com menos de 65 anos, sem dose inicial ou máxima própria. Idosos ou debilitados: início de 2 a 2,5 mg uma ou duas vezes ao dia. Insuficiência hepática leve ou moderada: metade da dose.

cite.locator: seção 2.1 Recommended Dosage in Adults Less Than 65 Years of Age (Table 1)
cite.quote: Short-term treatment of anxiety symptoms 2 mg to 10 mg, two to four times daily

cite.locator: Boxed warning: Risks from concomitant use with opioids; abuse, misuse, and addiction; and dependence and withdrawal reactions
cite.quote: Concomitant use of benzodiazepines and opioids may result in profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death.

cite.locator: Boxed warning: Risks from concomitant use with opioids; abuse, misuse, and addiction; and dependence and withdrawal reactions
cite.quote: The use of benzodiazepines, including VALIUM, exposes users to risks of abuse, misuse, and addiction, which can lead to overdose or death.
cite.note: Mesmo boxed warning: "The continued use of benzodiazepines, including VALIUM, may lead to clinically significant physical dependence."

cite.locator: Boxed warning: Risks from concomitant use with opioids; abuse, misuse, and addiction; and dependence and withdrawal reactions
cite.quote: Abrupt discontinuation or rapid dosage reduction of VALIUM after continued use may precipitate acute withdrawal reactions, which can be life-threatening.
cite.note: Mesmo boxed warning: "To reduce the risk of withdrawal reactions, use a gradual taper to discontinue VALIUM or reduce the dosage"

cite.quote: VALIUM produces additive CNS depressant effects, which can include potentially fatal respiratory depression, when used concomitantly with other medications that produce CNS depression, or with consumption of alcohol
cite.note: Seção 5.8: "Use of benzodiazepines, including VALIUM, either alone or in combination with other CNS depressants, may lead to potentially fatal respiratory depression"

cite.quote: Benzodiazepines, including VALIUM, may produce central nervous system (CNS) depression. Caution patients receiving VALIUM against engaging in hazardous occupations or activities requiring complete mental alertness (e.g., operating machinery or driving a motor vehicle).
cite.note: Seção 6: "Adverse reactions most commonly reported were drowsiness, fatigue, muscle weakness, and ataxia."

cite.quote: VALIUM is contraindicated in patients with acute narrow-angle glaucoma.
cite.note: Também listado na seção 4 Contraindications. Mesma seção 5.9: "Benzodiazepines, including VALIUM, can increase intraocular pressure in patients with glaucoma."

cite.locator: seção 2.2 Recommended Dosage in Specific Populations
cite.quote: VALIUM is not recommended in patients with severe hepatic impairment
cite.note: Mesma seção: "In patients with mild or moderate hepatic impairment, reduce the recommended dosage by half compared to those with normal hepatic function"

cite.locator: seção 7.3 Effects of Other Drugs on VALIUM (Table 3)
cite.quote: Based on tolerability, consider reducing the dosage of VALIUM during concomitant use with CYP3A4 or CYP2C19 inhibitors.
cite.note: Mesma tabela: "Based on clinical response, consider increasing the dosage of VALIUM during concomitant use with CYP3A4 or CYP2C19 inducers."

cite.locator: seção 5.10 Neonatal Sedation and Withdrawal Syndrome
cite.quote: Maternal use of VALIUM late in pregnancy can result in sedation (respiratory depression, lethargy, hypotonia) and/or withdrawal symptoms (hyperreflexia, irritability, restlessness, tremors, inconsolable crying, and feeding difficulties) in the neonate.
There are reports of sedation, poor feeding and poor weight gain in infants exposed to benzodiazepines through breast milk
cite.note: Mesma seção: "Infants exposed to VALIUM through breastmilk should be monitored for sedation, poor feeding, and poor weight gain."

monitoring.note: Alerta de classe dos antiepilépticos (não é boxed warning).

cite.quote: Patients treated with any AED for any indication should be monitored for the emergence or worsening of depression, suicidal thoughts or behavior, and/or any unusual changes in mood or behavior.
cite.note: Seção 5.6: "Monitor patients for worsening of preexisting depression."

review.notes: Doses de 2.1 convertidas para mg/dia (2–10 mg, 2 a 4 vezes ao dia). Fora por falta de id ou de suporte claro: inibidores/indutores da CYP2C19 (sem id próprio), piora de depressão preexistente, cautela na insuficiência respiratória, suicidalidade dos antiepilépticos (entra só como monitoramento), superdosagem (fatal só em combinação). Sem fato renal: a seção 12.3 diz que a depuração do diazepam livre na insuficiência renal crônica é semelhante à de voluntários saudáveis.
